problem_solving_patterns.title: Stay With the Problem
problem_solving_patterns.statement: When I am genuinely interested in something, I remain dedicated to it even when I face difficulties. I continue learning, experimenting, and working toward a solution instead of stopping midway.
behavior: Continue until the work is completed or the objective is achieved.
problem_solving_patterns.core_belief: Difficulties are part of the learning and problem-solving process.

problem_solving_patterns.title: Learn What the Problem Requires
problem_solving_patterns.statement: When I encounter something I do not understand, I use learning as part of solving the problem. I acquire the knowledge or skill required and then apply it practically.
process: Identify what I do not know.

problem_solving_patterns.title: Work Toward Completion
problem_solving_patterns.statement: When I commit to something that interests me, I want to take it toward completion rather than leaving it unfinished without a meaningful reason.
problem_solving_patterns.rule: Commitment should be followed by consistent effort toward completion.

problem_solving_patterns.title: Improve Through Experimentation
problem_solving_patterns.statement: I use experimentation and practical application to improve my understanding and capabilities.
